{{Quote|Colonel Narl has a pretty big crew. The Blackguard use some pretty strange powers, but the Colonel outnumbers them. They seem to have developed a truce of sorts. The two sides have divided the ruins between them and leave each other alone. Of course, whenever anyone new shows up, they both turn on the newcomer.|[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Mi Fon Lu]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DMFL" />}}
The '''Treasure Hunters''' were a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and archaeological looters led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Narl]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were present in the [[Southern Jedi Ruins]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Treasure Hunters appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SJR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Treasure Hunters were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:SJR" />
